# Shopify robots.txt — search-safe AI crawler rules
#
# Paste this into your Shopify robots.txt editor (Online Store > Preferences > robots.txt).
# This BLOCKS the 8 training crawlers (opts out of model training, costs nothing
# in search) and ALLOWS the 7 search/answer crawlers (keeps you in ChatGPT, Perplexity,
# Claude, Alexa, Siri answers).
#
# Generated by aivis --training-optout, verified against 165 vendor-sourced crawlers.
# See: https://github.com/krisdiallo/ecom-agent/blob/main/crawlers.json

# ---- TRAINING CRAWLERS: block these (costs nothing in search) ----
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: ClaudeBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /

User-agent: Amazonbot
Disallow: /

User-agent: Applebot-Extended
Disallow: /

User-agent: meta-externalagent
Disallow: /

# ---- SEARCH/ANSWER CRAWLERS: allow these (removing you from AI answers) ----
# Do NOT block these unless you specifically want to be invisible to AI search.
User-agent: OAI-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: PerplexityBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Claude-User
Allow: /

User-agent: Amzn-SearchBot
Allow: /

User-agent: Amzn-User
Allow: /

User-agent: Applebot
Allow: /

# ---- SHOPIFY-SPECIFIC PATHS ----
# Keep Shopify's default faceted-nav rules intact. These are normal
# and should NOT be removed. The rules above only add AI crawler directives.
